hero.title: Operators building for the public good
hero.sub: PubliX Group unites founder-led SaaS companies that digitise public services across Northern Europe. We're operators — not financial engineers. Every decision we make starts with one question: does this help our companies build better products?

thesis.title: Public-sector software is its own discipline
thesis.p1: Public sector means procurement rules, framework agreements, long sales cycles and regulated buyers. It requires patience, domain expertise and a deep understanding of how the public sector actually buys technology. PubliX concentrates in this one vertical — and intends to be the best in the Nordics. When a founder joins PubliX, they get a parent company that truly understands their market.
thesis.p2: We grow through shared customers and cross-selling. Our companies sell to the same and adjacent customers — municipalities, regions, foundations, public agencies. Cross-selling and collaboration between portfolio companies grows revenue organically. Every company keeps its own brand, its identity and its autonomy.

tracks.title: Two tracks. One goal: make your company stronger.
tracks.sub: Every company we work with benefits from two parallel value creation tracks — one focused on strengthening your foundation, the other on accelerating growth.
tracks.c1_sub: Strengthen the operational core so you can scale with confidence.
tracks.c1_i1: Clean economics — clear reporting, margins and unit economics
tracks.c1_i2: Sensible pricing — value-based models that capture what you're worth
tracks.c1_i3: Commercial discipline — pipeline management and sales processes
tracks.c1_i4: Security & compliance uplift — ISO 27001, GDPR, public-sector standards
tracks.c1_i5: AI & engineering capability — embedded tech expertise, not consultants
tracks.c2_sub: Expand your market reach through the power of the platform.
tracks.c2_i1: Sell more to shared customers — cross-sell across the portfolio
tracks.c2_i2: Open new Nordic countries for proven products
tracks.c2_i3: Add adjacent workflows for the same buyer persona
tracks.c2_i4: Joint marketing & events to shared decision-makers
tracks.c2_i5: Warm introductions through trusted existing relationships
tracks.callout: "Founders typically reinvest part of their proceeds into the group, sharing in the value of the whole platform rather than just selling and leaving."
tracks.callout_cite: — This is by design. When founders stay invested, incentives stay aligned.

ai.title:
AI is how we create value:
Every product, every workflow, every job role
ai.sub: We don't just talk about AI — we embed it across every company in the group. From new product capabilities to automating internal operations, AI is central to how PubliX creates value.
ai.c1_desc: We help our companies build AI-powered features into their products — from intelligent automation to predictive analytics for public-sector workflows.
ai.c2_desc: We automate lead generation, lead nurture, customer support, software development and financial and administrative workflows across the group — so our companies can focus on building great products instead of admin.
ai.c3_desc: We train every team across the group to use AI tools effectively — turning capability into results. Our companies reach their goals faster than they thought possible.

quote.text: "We do everything we can together with the companies — while letting them stay independent. Collaboration is one of the most important things we do: where founders once had ten colleagues, they now have a hundred, and that collaboration continues long after they get home."

cta.title: Thinking about your next chapter?
cta.sub: Whether you're exploring your options, curious about where your company stands, or just want to talk to someone who understands your market — we'd welcome the conversation.
